body:
## Purpose
A spec with designs now goes through three approvals: accept a variant in the viewer, answer the design question with "Approve this design", and Approve the spec. Make it one: approving in the design viewer is the design sign-off and approves the spec. No design question.

## Requirements
1. The review panel's Accept becomes Approve. On a spec with variants, each variant has its own Approve (the panel's for the selected variant, plus one on each variant's label on the whole board), so one click picks and approves a variant. Without variants there is one "Approve design".
2. Approving the design (or a variant) approves the spec, the same as Approve on its card, and reaches Claude's inbox as an approval naming the variant. If the spec has open questions, Approve is disabled with the reason, as on the card.
3. Reject (with a reason, multiline) stays per variant, or for the whole design. It does not reject the spec; it reaches Claude as design feedback to rework.
4. On a spec with designs not yet approved, the card's and sheet's Approve open the design viewer instead of approving, with the hint "Approve the design to approve the spec".
5. Undo approval in the viewer is gone; reverting works as for any approved spec.
6. Design questions go away: spill_ask no longer takes design: true, and the MCP instructions, the spill_ask description and SPILL.md tell Claude to ask for design sign-off by pointing the user at the viewer (a comment on the spec), not by asking a question. Old answered design questions stay on the board as they are.
7. A spec with variants records which variant was approved; the approved snapshot (S-47) marks it.

## Out of scope
- Shift+click behavior (separate spec).
- Moving the viewer to its own window (separate spec).
- Approving several variants at once.

## Acceptance checks
1. On a board copy, Approve on variant B in the viewer moves the spec to approved, and the inbox shows the approval with variant B. No question was involved.
2. With an open question on the spec, the viewer's Approve is disabled and says why.
3. The card's Approve on a spec with unapproved designs opens the viewer.
4. Rejecting a variant leaves the spec's status unchanged and reaches the inbox with the reason.
5. spill_ask with design: true is refused, and the instructions no longer mention design questions.

## Purpose
A spec with designs now goes through three approvals: accept a variant in the viewer, answer the design question, and Approve the spec. Keep one: the design question. The viewer is for looking and commenting (pins and comment threads); it has no Accept or Reject. Answering the question picks the variant (or approves the design when there are no variants) and approves the spec, as a design question's A does today.

## Requirements
1. The viewer's review panel loses Accept, Reject and Undo accept. It keeps pins, comment threads and replies.
2. A design question's options come from the spec's designs:
   - With variants: one option per variant ("A. Variant A", "B. Variant B", ...), then a last option "Needs changes".
   - Without variants: "A. Approve this design" and "B. Needs changes".
   Claude passes design: true and the app builds the options; any options in the body are ignored.
3. Answering with a variant (or "Approve this design") approves the spec it blocks and records the chosen variant on the spec. It reaches Claude's inbox as an answer naming the variant.
4. "Needs changes" keeps the spec unapproved and reopens nothing by itself; Claude reworks the design from the pins and comments and the user's answer text, then reopens the same question (as today).
5. The design question card has an "Open designs" link that opens the viewer on the spec's whole board (or its one design).
6. A spec with designs and no answered design question cannot be approved from its card; the card points to the design question instead (replacing "Accept the design or a variant first").
7. The viewer and the sheet's Designs section mark the chosen variant once the question is answered ("Chosen"), and the approved snapshot (S-47) records it. Other variants show no status.
8. The MCP instructions, the spill_ask description and SPILL.md say: design sign-off is one design question per spec; do not list options for it; the viewer is only for comments.
9. Existing accept and reject records in feedback.json are left as they are and are no longer shown.

## Out of scope
- Shift+click behavior (S-50).
- Moving the viewer to its own window (S-51).
- Choosing several variants.

## Acceptance checks
1. On a board copy, a design question for a spec with variants A, B, C shows options A, B, C and "Needs changes"; answering B approves the spec and the inbox shows variant B.
2. A spec without variants gets "Approve this design" and "Needs changes".
3. The viewer has no Accept or Reject; pins and comments still work.
4. The question card's "Open designs" opens the viewer.
5. After answering B, the viewer and the sheet mark B as chosen.
6. The card's Approve on a spec with designs and an open design question is disabled and points to the question.
